notes.content:
Hey all! A hot fix is now out addressing achievements for Button City on Windows. This was due to the Steam API not initializing correctly. Thank you for your patience. If you have any issues please either submit a comment in the bug thread or email support@subliminalgaming.com

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fix to Steam initialization
[/list]

notes.title: Button City 1.0.5 Bug fixes and easier controlling
notes.content:
Button City 1.0.5 is out now on Steam and with it we bring a number fixes and updates to controller input.

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock on day one after joining Fluff Squad.
[*] Fixed a softlock during day 4 after hanging out with Lavender.
[*] Fixed a softlock during day 4 after getting the trenchcoat and trying to speak with Sorrel.
[*] Made OpenGL the default on mac devices due to a rendering issue. This can be changed by running with -force-metal command in the command line arguments in Steam.
[*] Fixed the Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S controller layout for macOS
[*] Fixed UI being outside screen safe zone
[/list]

[u]Game Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Updated controller input so it's easier to select things like doors and other interactables.
[*] Added Wishlist button to titlescreen for Button City: Soccer Days.
[*] Built macOS version to support Apple Silicon.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy Button City!

If you haven't yet please wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2417530/Button_City_Soccer_Days/]Button City: Soccer Days[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 now available!
notes.content:
With this patch we focused on hunting down more pesky bugs that have been crawling deep in the corners of the game! This patch addresses major issues with Prismabeats and more! If you have any issues please let us know in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273750/discussions/0/5503948370876035961/]community thread[/url].

Thank you and have fun!
-Subliminal

- Fixed an issue with Prismabeats not loading songs properly
- Fixed an issue where the Quest Log would show the wrong tasks in Japanese
- Fixed an issue where arcade games would make screen black on day six when returning
- Updated a quest icon to have the correct character
- Fixed a sequence break for Orthoplex
- Fixed an issue where some NPC's wouldn't set up correctly after an arcade challenge
- Fixed a softlock when using the One vs the World Fluff Buff in Gobabots
- Fixed an issue where the Final battle would get stuck at 2:00 mark
- Fixed an issue where trophies would not check correctly on startup
- Fixed Sorrel being listed twice on day 6
- Fixed an issue where lemonade game would stop all game music
- Fixed an issue where the Sorrel Metal Yoga quest would not show up
- Fixed issue where macOS was not showing Steam overlay on Steam

notes.title: 1.0.2.1 Hot Patch Fix
notes.content: Fixes an issue where players who received the motor in gameplay got it taken away. It will now correct your save file on start. This will fix the issue of not having the motor Fluff Buff in arcade games.

notes.title: Button City version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Button City version 1.0.2[/h1]

This patch addresses bugs and stability.

- Increased Fennel’s speed.
- Speech bubble now hides correctly when talking to Valarian
- Fix to music venue causing a black screen soft lock 
- Camera no longer jitters when returning from rEVolution Racer
- Restructured Yes No Maybe quest to fix issues
- Yes No Maybe now correctly gives item, you can return to them if you didn’t receive the item.
- Fixed sequence break on day 1 when talking to Sorrel
- Sorrel now does challenge when challenging her
- Tuff Fluff challenges no longer cause black screen and soft lock
- Chive cinematic no longer resets on day 2
- The pay phone no longer causes a broken cinematic and sequence break on day 4
- Goba Academy now resets correctly
- Motor is no longer removed during story progression so players can use the Fluff Buff in arcade games.
- Prismabeats no longer stops audio in the main game when losing
- Fix to Mint disappearing during Prismabeats quest
- More robust checking on file saving and loading
- Fix to Gobabots AI taking over for player if they restart during a story sequence
- Wrestling quest fix to characters not showing up when starting with Lavender in the scene.
- Made more robust checks for climatic Gobabot battle when Golden berries appear.
- Sage now correctly talks during the chase sequence on Day 5
- Dog bots no are no longer talkable during chase sequence to avoid issue of player movement.
- Fix to Mechamelon and other heavy Gobabots hurtboxes not registering.

If you have any issues please either post them on the Steam Community Page https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273750/discussions/0/ or at our Support page https://www.buttoncitygame.com/support

notes.title: YARRR! Join us at IWOCon 🦜
notes.content:
[h1]Button City Booth[/h1]
[h3]March 26 - April 2nd[/h3]

YARR! IWOCon is here, mateys! 🦜 Set sail for our digital booth today! IWOCon 2021 is a convention app from Indie World Order showcasing upcoming & current indie games. 

Digital booths open today! Get the IWOCon app for FREE on Steam to gain admission to the conference.

⭐ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1422300/IWOCon_2021/][b]Download on Steam[/b][/url]

[h2]Cap'n Fennel Sets Sail[/h2]

Find our booth all the way at the top of the map, on Smiley Island 🏝️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37894276/8f2e3646daa9bfa3614b36fa501994b991fbaf77.jpg[/img]

Hmm... Cap'n Fennel found a strange missive hidden amongst his joke books! He's not sure how it got there...

Maybe you can help him out... Investigate the Button City booth 🔎👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37894276/483549a2852c73fedecb53bb3fd46c38dc76b526.jpg[/img]

[h3]What is IWOCon?[/h3]

IWOCon 2021 is a free indie game convention based on a stylized pirate theme. There is a collection of islands, each island hosting several booths. Conference attendees can select their avatar & travel around these islands, where they can explore different booths, watch trailers, get information on games and products, enter giveaways, & engage in extra activities, all while having a bit of light-hearted, pirate-themed fun! [url=https://www.indieworldorder.com/iwocon]Learn More[/url]

notes.title: Button City revealed during the Wholesome Direct
notes.content:
[h2]Hello from Button City[/h2]
[previewyoutube=AwCNzOPR8Ck;full][/previewyoutube]

We're so excited to finally open up our Steam page alongside our reveal announcement during the Wholesome Direct brought together by the Wholesome Games community. The event was hosted on the Wholesome Games YouTube bringing together over 50 indies that showcased cute, warm, and most importantly wholesome games.

Button City opened the event showing our reveal trailer where we teased some of the story, the characters you'll meet and team up with, and some of the arcade games you'll play including the 4 vs 4 berry bot battler Gobabots and the electric drift racing game rEVolution Racer.

Make sure to watch the Wholesome Direct and wishlist Button City and the other games from the direct on Steam.
